name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) matches 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' — a rule-only conditional with no unconditional goal, so empty FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning are correct. The siren only stops when the switch is toggled, and at the toggle step siren_ringing is false (as in the example trace), so switch_toggled lands after the last siren_ringing step and the Response closes cleanly after each ring; no Existence, order, or extra clause is required or present.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, the agent must toggle the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
